if.script: def remember = ec.web.sessionAttributes.remove('zenithRememberMe') == 'Y' ec.web.sessionAttributes.remove('zenithLoginOrgId') def cookie = new jakarta.servlet.http.Cookie('moquiLoginKey', remember ? ec.user.getLoginKey(720) : '') cookie.maxAge = remember ? 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 : 0 cookie.path = "/" cookie.httpOnly = true cookie.secure = ec.web.request.isSecure() ec.web.response.addCookie(cookie)

actions.script: ec.user.logoutUser() ec.web.sessionAttributes.remove('zenithRememberMe') ec.web.sessionAttributes.remove('zenithLoginOrgId') def cookie = new jakarta.servlet.http.Cookie("moquiLoginKey", "") cookie.maxAge = 0 cookie.path = "/" cookie.httpOnly = true cookie.secure = ec.web.request.isSecure() ec.web.response.addCookie(cookie)
ec.message.clearAll() ec.message.addMessage("If an account matches that username, a password reset has been sent to its registered email address.")
